title: Adapter spec v1 sql operation appendix (Postgres family)
description: Refines the sql step shape for database providers. Statements are static parameterized text with executor-owned identifier quoting; params bind from inputs/credentials only. Normative prose: adapter-registry plan 02 section 2.7 (finalized at build).

alphabet.description: Executor-owned CSPRNG alphabet safe for SQL literals and URLs.

statement.description: Static SQL with {{ident:name}} (executor-quoted identifier, bound to an input) and {{param:name}} (bound value: generated credential or input). No other interpolation; free ${...} in statements is rejected.

dsn_role.description: Template for the role to log in as (input-bound, never credential).

dsn_password.description: One of ${minted_credential} (mint/test) or an input reference. Admin-credential references are rejected here: probes authenticate as the ROTATED identity, never the admin.
